entries.title: FRUMA EXPANSION UPDATE
entries.contents:
Updated the modpack to work with the Fruma Expansion

  • New mods: Atmosfera, Show Me Your Skin, Immersive UI, OctoLib, Ixeris, ImmediatelyFast, No Chat Clear, Longer Chat History, Windy, Wynncraft Hide Pets, WynnIris
  • REMOVED: UkuLib, Cupboard
  • UPDATED: Wynntils, Voices of Wynn, Sodium, Fabric Api, Fabric Language Kotlin

entries.title: 1.21.11 UPDATE
entries.contents:
Updated the modpack to 1.21.11

  • New VOXY render distance support
  • REMOVED: Wynncraft Donjons, Wynncraft Fables and Legends, Falling Leaves(replaced by Particular), Iceberg, Legendary Tooltips, Prism Lib, Ukulib, Wynncraft Tooltips
  • UPDATED: Wynntils & Voices of Wynn

entries.title: Major Installer Overhaul
entries.contents:
Complete rework of the installer

  • New functions and customizability
  • NEW: Better Grassify, Better Clouds, Better Mount HUD, Bad Optimizations, Cool Raid, DISTANT HORIZONS, Immersive Hotbar, Particular, Simple Fog Control, Subtle Effects, Variants-CIT, Wynn-Vista, Wynn-Stacks, No Armor, Clearer Water & Gentler Weather Sounds
  • UPDATED: Wynntils & Voices of Wynn

entries.title: Minor Mod Update
entries.contents:
This update updated certain mods:

  • UPDATED: CIDADA, Wynntils

entries.title: New Visual Enhancements
entries.contents:
This release brings new visual improvements and other updates:

  • ADDED: AutoHUD, Legendary Tooltips, Tiny Item Animations, RemoveHUD, BetterFPSRD, Iceberg, Prism & Wakes
  • UPDATED: Cupboard, Voices of Wynn & Wynntils
  • Made the Wynntils Preset Config optional

entries.title: Minor Fix
entries.contents: Fixed a GUI issue caused by Immediately Fast

entries.title: Major Modpack Update
entries.contents:
Major update bringing all modpacks to Minecraft 1.21.4

  • ADDED: Particular & Zoomify
  • UPDATED: Wynntils & Voices of Wynn
  • Updated the Legacy Pack to 1.21

entries.title: Major Modpack Update
entries.contents:
Updated all modpacks to Minecraft 1.21

  • Created a new light-weight modpack: MAJESTIC LITE
  • Created a new beta testing modpack: BETA PACK

entries.title: Initial Release
entries.contents:
First public release of the Wynncraft Overhaul modpack installer! Features include:

  • Easy one-click installation
  • Support for multiple launchers
  • Customizable mod selection
